indexes.indexdef: CREATE INDEX idx_vc_category ON public.violation_cases USING btree (category) WHERE (is_deleted = false)

CREATE INDEX idx_vc_conversion_rank ON public.violation_cases USING btree (weighted_conversion_rate DESC, total_views DESC) WHERE ((is_deleted = false) AND (purpose = 'conversion'::text) AND (usage_count >= 3) AND (total_views >= 1000))
CREATE INDEX idx_vc_created ON public.violation_cases USING btree (created_at DESC) WHERE (is_deleted = false)
CREATE INDEX idx_vc_purpose_status_created ON public.violation_cases USING btree (purpose, status, created_at DESC) WHERE (is_deleted = false)
CREATE INDEX idx_vc_script_hash ON public.violation_cases USING btree (script_hash) WHERE (is_deleted = false)
CREATE INDEX idx_vc_script_search ON public.violation_cases USING gin (to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, script_text)) WHERE (is_deleted = false)
CREATE INDEX idx_vc_status ON public.violation_cases USING btree (status) WHERE (is_deleted = false)
CREATE INDEX idx_vc_team ON public.violation_cases USING btree (team_id) WHERE (is_deleted = false)
CREATE INDEX idx_violation_cases_public_lookup ON public.violation_cases USING btree (usage_state, promotion_level, status) WHERE (is_deleted = false)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX violation_cases_pkey ON public.violation_cases USING btree (id)

policies.with_check: ((auth.role() = 'authenticated'::text) AND (auth.uid() = submitted_by) AND ((account_id IS NULL) OR owns_account(account_id)))

constraints.name: violation_cases_account_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES accounts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: violation_cases_category_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((category = ANY (ARRAY['下粉'::text, '直播'::text, '短视频'::text, '其他'::text])))

constraints.name: violation_cases_parent_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES violation_cases(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: violation_cases_platforms_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((array_length(platforms, 1) IS NULL) OR ((array_length(platforms, 1) >= 1) AND (array_length(platforms, 1) <= 4) AND (platforms <@ ARRAY['抖音'::text, '视频号'::text, '小红书'::text, '其他'::text]))))

constraints.name: violation_cases_submitted_by_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (submitted_by) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: violation_cases_team_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (team_id) REFERENCES teams(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
